title: Saudi Fried Sesame Seed Fritters
description: Crispy fried fritters filled with a nutty sesame seed mixture, inspired by Saudi cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sesame seeds, and salt. Mix well.
2. Add sesame oil to the dry mixture and mix until crumbly.
3. Gradually add fry mix to the mixture and mix until well combined.
4. Gradually add water to the mixture to form a dough.
5. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
6. Divide the dough into small portions.
7. Roll each portion into a ball and then flatten into a disk.
8. Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
9. Fry fritters until golden brown and crispy.
10. Remove fritters from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
11. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
